linkage: POSIX libc; macOS additionally compiles c/darwin_shim.c with include path c and system libdispatch APIs. No private APIs, Blocks, additional std.Io pool, or core pinning.
lifetime: All accepted heap jobs allocated by the supplied concurrent-free allocator transfer ownership. Callbacks run exactly once even after cancellation, must check job.cancel and release their own callback scratch allocations, and must neither free their envelope nor release its scratch_reservation. Executor destroys envelope then releases reservation after callback returns. Cancel tokens/userdata and parent arenas live through drain/waitIdle. Only owner deinit joins workers or barriers all GCD queues. Nested callback waits/new pool initialization are refused.
permit_model: One executor is the process/broker global owner shared by all tasks/workspaces. Waiting queue is 64 global/16 session; execution CPU and conservative one-per-FD-bearing-job IO permits are independent. CPU reservation is max(1, scratch_reservation.cpu). Reserve up to 2 short-foreground CPU permits without preventing non-short progress at cap=1. Callbacks perform synchronous operations and enqueue future bounded chunks here. A blocked selected service turn protects its entire required CPU/non-short/I/O grant; smaller jobs may use only spare resources beyond that grant. Idle admission also requires zero active foreground callbacks.
